summary: A supplied vector reconstruction of British Columbia Place Ltd.'s b/c/p symbol and three-line wordmark, rebuilt after page 4 of the programme for BC Place Stadium's grand opening gala, 19 June 1983 (a scanned PDF, 2023-F0003-24). See package-README.md and review/comparison.webp. The package's black and white adaptations are not documented historical variants and are not used.

assets.label: British Columbia Place Ltd. — Symbol and wordmark, vector reconstruction
assets.sourceLocator: Rebuilt after the grand-opening gala programme of 19 June 1983, page 4 (scanned PDF 2023-F0003-24); also on the 1983 annual report's cover
assets.sourceFile: BC Place grand opening gala programme, 1983
assets.dateNote: The programme and the annual report are of 1983, the year the stadium opened; the mark's introduction is not dated.
assets.notes: The blue b/c/p symbol — bowls on a shared stem inside a fine offset outline — beside “british columbia place” on three staggered lines.
assets.fidelityNote: A supplied vector reconstruction, not original artwork: the symbol is built geometrically (equal circular bowls on an equilateral grid, two stems, a fine offset outline) and each letter is a custom outline after the scan (no automatic tracing). The wordmark is consistent with ITC Bauhaus; the weight and any modifications are unconfirmed. The blue (#3093D2) is sampled from the scan, not an original specification. The annual-report image is kept as a download.
